title: Erroneous erasure cannot be rolled back
statement: Rollback of an erroneous erasure is impossible by design; the guard is prevention and logging of the operator who issued it.

evidence.excerpt: request payload and logs the operator who issued it

conflicts.note: no authentication; requester hard-coded, so the operator is not known

meaning: Only authorised, identified people may trigger an erasure
impact: Target restricts erasure to a DPO group with audit of the caller

title: Erasure audit record
statement: Each erasure writes an audit record (request, customer, layers, completion time, confirmation hash) to the audit table and file.

evidence.excerpt: Every execution writes a tamper-evident record:

conflicts.note: hash is unkeyed sha256(request_id:customer_id)[:16], not tamper-evident

meaning: Proof that each request was carried out
impact: Target audit records per-store verification; consider a keyed hash

title: No stale lake copy after erasure
statement: Silver/Gold Parquet exports must be re-snapshotted after erasure so that a deleted customer does not survive in a stale lake copy.

evidence.excerpt: A deleted customer must not survive in a stale lake copy

meaning: Every exported copy must follow erasure
impact: Exports become shares of governed tables, not file copies
risk: Hugging Face history keeps old versions (FND-04)

recommendation.reason: stated; currently unmet for the public dataset

title: Erasure is idempotent and replayable
statement: Running the same erasure twice gives the same end state, and an unfinished request is replayed after a worker crash.

evidence.excerpt: same end state. Anonymize operations are `SET column = <anonymized>` (not

meaning: Retrying an erasure is always safe
impact: Target job keyed by request id (DEV job already has idempotency_key)

title: No non-consenting customer in marketing aggregates
statement: No customer without marketing consent may flow into marketing-facing aggregates.

evidence.excerpt: - Consent-aware data modeling: no non-consenting customer flows into

conflicts.note: README says no downstream marketing-serving filter exists

meaning: Marketing may only use customers who agreed
impact: Consent-gated Gold view or row filter (DEV gold_consent_gated exists)
risk: Art. 6/7 breach if marketing reads customer_360 directly

title: PII gate fails on unregistered PII-like columns
statement: The pipeline seeds the PII manifest on first run and fails when a new PII-like column appears; the gate must not be disabled (false positives preferred).

evidence.excerpt: We are not disabling the gate. A false-positive here is preferable to a

meaning: New personal-data columns must be registered before data moves on
impact: Port as a fail-closed check or UC data classification with an alert
risk: Heuristic false positives stop the pipeline (incident 2026-001)

title: Fraud rules: velocity, amount z-score, geo mismatch
statement: VELOCITY (>5 payments per 300 s, HIGH), AMOUNT_ZSCORE (z>3.0, MEDIUM, current payment excluded) and GEO_MISMATCH (billing != merchant country, LOW).

evidence.excerpt: | GEO_MISMATCH | billing country ≠ merchant country | LOW |

meaning: The three fraud signals the business relies on
impact: Ported into a streaming job with the same thresholds

recommendation.reason: doc and code agree except window type

title: Residency must be provable
statement: The platform must prove residency (evidence of region per store), not only assert it.

evidence.excerpt: The platform must prove residency, not just assert it.

meaning: Region must be demonstrable to an auditor
impact: Posture check per wave; region recorded per external location
risk: Third-party stores (Turso, HF, Aiven) have no region evidence today

title: Bronze PII masked on erasure
statement: On erasure, Bronze email, iban and ip_address are overwritten with <anonymized>; rows are kept.
meaning: Raw records stay for continuity but lose their personal fields
impact: Delta UPDATE + VACUUM so old file versions do not keep PII
risk: Delta time travel keeps the clear values unless vacuumed

title: Erased customer fully removed from Silver, Gold and alerts
statement: Silver customers/orders/payments, Gold customer_360/order_facts/fraud_summary and bronze.fraud_alerts rows of an erased customer are deleted and must not survive.

conflicts.note: reproduced: rows return after a full rebuild

meaning: Derived data about an erased person must be gone for good
impact: Every rebuild filters suppressed ids; regression test in the pipeline
risk: Current system fails this after a full rebuild (FND-01)

title: Erasure completes within 60 s
statement: An erasure request must complete end-to-end within 60 seconds (EUROSTREAM_ERASURE_SLA_SECONDS); breaches are counted in erasure_sla_breach.
meaning: The client's own deadline for completing a right-to-be-forgotten request
impact: Sizes the Databricks erasure job (serverless start-up, refresh barrier)
risk: A Delta DELETE + refresh may not fit 60 s; the SLA may need renegotiating

recommendation.reason: stated in architecture doc and implemented in code

title: Quality gate blocks publication
statement: All data-quality checks must pass; the DAG aborts if any gate fails.

evidence.excerpt: | Data quality | all checks pass | DAG aborts if any gate fails |

meaning: Nothing is published when data quality checks fail
impact: Expectations with fail semantics on Gold

title: Silver PII pseudonymised with salted SHA-256
statement: Silver stores configured PII fields as sha256(salt:value); data is pseudonymised, not anonymous.

evidence.excerpt: Why salted hash instead of format-preserving encryption?

meaning: Silver is still personal data under GDPR
impact: Silver tables tagged PII and covered by erasure and access policy

title: Salt from a secret manager, rotated per environment
statement: EUROSTREAM_PII_SALT must be injected from a secret manager and rotated per environment in production; the default is public.

evidence.excerpt: `EUROSTREAM_PII_SALT` defaults to a public value. Production

meaning: The hashing key must be secret

title: EU-only storage and processing
statement: All storage and processing must be pinned to EU regions at provider level, with no cross-border transfer, no US DR replica and no temporary processing outside the EU.

evidence.excerpt: All storage and processing is pinned to EU regions:

meaning: The client's residency decision for all personal data
impact: Target workspace, metastore and storage in an EU region; DEV in us-east-2 cannot hold real data
risk: Regulatory breach if real data lands in the current DEV
